notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run wD-077) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached and no hardware or sim backend was run. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's GymnasiumDriver/family-config shape cannot express this upstream. TrifingerEnv derives from the repository's own IsaacEnvBase, not from gym.Env or gymnasium.Env (leibnizgym/envs/env_base.py:79), and has no action_space, observation_space or env_id (leibnizgym/envs/trifinger/trifinger_env.py:118); a GymnasiumDriver derives the whole contract from spaces the clone does not define. The package is therefore a direct Driver over the clone's entry class (native leibnizgym.envs.trifinger.trifinger_env:TrifingerEnv) with the package fake. cap.world.step.v1 takes ticks plus a nine-value normalized action object (values); the action envelope is the normalized [-1, 1] range (leibnizgym/envs/trifinger/trifinger_env.py:45-46, :654-659; leibnizgym/wrappers/vec_task.py:34-56). cap.world.reset.v1 calls TrifingerEnv.reset() and applies a supplied or pending seed through the upstream static seed method (leibnizgym/envs/env_base.py:312-320). cap.world.seed.v1 calls the same method, sets the pending seed and returns accepted. NOT COVERED: the real IsaacGym/PhysX simulation, PyTorch tensors and the TriFinger assets (IsaacGym Preview Release 2 is an external dependency; README.md:7-17, and nothing was installed or run); the fake is a pure Python kinematic stand-in that models one instance, a placeholder nine-value joint offset and a placeholder 41-value observation row, not contacts, actuators, sensors or the upstream reward terms, and it was never compared with upstream. Only the default configuration is modelled (position command mode, normalized action, episode length 750); torque and position_impedance modes, asymmetric observations, force-torque sensors and rendering are not modelled. The upstream is vectorized ([num_instances, obs_dim]) while the driver returns the first instance's row, so num_instances above 1 is not exposed. The upstream auto-resets at episode_length (leibnizgym/envs/env_base.py:392-395); the driver reports truncated at 750 ticks and requires an explicit reset instead of continuing. Snapshot and restore are not offered because the environment exposes no get_state/set_state. No sim backend is served; only the fake backend is declared. The gate reported no warnings, including no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning. Only catalogue classes are bound, so there are no catalogue requests and no extension ids. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
